The *Ajitamāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 5), rendered in English as "Exposition of the Questions of the Student Ajita," is an exegetical text preserved in the *Cūḷaniddesa* of the Pali canon [SuttaCentral]. It constitutes an exposition of the *Ajitamāṇavapucchā* (Snp 5.2) from the *Pārāyanavagga* of the *Sutta Nipāta* [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records two translations in two languages, and notes that the text or its verses are referenced across a range of canonical and post-canonical Buddhist works, including the *Aṅguttara Nikāya* (AN 3.86, AN 7.85), the *Saṁyutta Nikāya* (SN 12.31), the *Nettippakaraṇa* (Ne 5, Ne 16), the *Peṭakopadesa* (Pe 1, Pe 5), the *Gaṅgamālajātaka* (Ja 421), the Chinese *Saṁyuktāgama* (SA 821), and the *Śarīrārthagāthā* [SuttaCentral].
Curated passage-level parallels identified by SuttaCentral link the treatise to several discourses in the *Mahāniddesa* (Mnd 1, Mnd 2, Mnd 7, Mnd 14), the *Cūḷaniddesa* (Cnd 22), and Abhidhamma treatises such as the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī* (Ds 2.1.1, Ds 2.3.2) and *Vibhaṅga* (Vb 17), with resembling parallels in Cnd 8, Cnd 11, the *Milindapañha* (Mil 7.8.7), and the *Paṭisambhidāmagga* (Ps 3.9) [SuttaCentral]. DharmaNexus detects 4,682 matching passages shared across 205 Pali texts, highlighting especially heavy shared doctrinal stock with the *Tuvaṭakasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 14), *Sāriputtasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 16), *Khaggavisāṇasuttaniddesa* (Cnd 23), *Kāmasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 1), *Mettagūmāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 8), and *Dukanikkhepa* (Ds 2.3.2) [DharmaNexus]. SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus agree on significant shared passages with Mnd 1, Mnd 2, Mnd 7, Mnd 14, Ds 2.3.2, and Vb 17 [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also aligns recurring doctrinal segments (such as §27.9) with Sanskrit and Tibetan literature, including the *Saṅghabhedavastu*, *Lalitavistara*, *Arthaviniścayasūtra*, the Tibetan *Vinayavastu*, and the *Abhiniṣkramaṇasūtra* [DharmaNexus].
